select t1.id, t1.username, t1.nickname, t1.phone, t1.email, t2.name as dept_name from sys_user t1 left join sys_dept t2 on t1.dept_id = t2.id and t2.deleted = 0 left join sys_user_role t3 on t1.id = t3.user_id and t3.deleted = 0 and t3.role_id = #{roleId} where t1.deleted = 0 and t3.id is null
and t1.dept_id in #{item}
and ( t1.username like concat('%', #{key}, '%') or t1.nickname like concat('%', #{key}, '%') )
and t1.is_super_admin = 0
